verdict.rationale: Poly's docs describe an official `poly` command-line tool that ships inside the desktop app. It makes your files "searchable and scriptable from the terminal" and has a documented command reference (cp, wget, search, memory summary). An official `poly-cli` agent skill teaches agents to compose these commands, which squarely serves the AI-native workflow, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and a standalone install (the CLI requires the desktop app).
